blocks.text: Minerals inorganic substances (maadde) hain jo jaandaron ki zindagi ke kuch zaroori physiochemical processes (jism ke physical aur chemical kaam) jaari rakhne ke liye chahiye. Yeh energy nahi dete, lekin mukhtalif activities (kaamon) mein in ke ahem kaam hain.

Minerals ko do bari qismon mein baanta jata hai: macro (major, zyada miqdar mein chahiye) aur micro (trace, thori miqdar mein chahiye) elements. Macro-minerals mein calcium, phosphorus, sodium, potassium, magnesium, chloride aur sulfur shamil hain. Micro-elements mein iron, copper, cobalt, iodine, zinc, manganese, molybdenum, fluoride, chromium aur selenium shamil hain. Macro-minerals rozana 100 mg se zyada aur micro-minerals rozana 100 mg se kam chahiye hote hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke macro-minerals '100 mg/dL' se zyada aur micro-minerals is se kam chahiye. mg/dL khoon mein concentration ki unit hai, zaroorat ki nahi; sahi had taqreeban 100 mg rozana (per day) hai. Kitab potassium, magnesium aur sulfur ko micro (trace) elements mein ginti hai; yeh rozana 100 mg se zyada chahiye, is liye macro-minerals hain. Oopar dono baatein durust likhi gayi hain.

blocks.caption: Table 27.1 Nutrition (khurak) mein iron, calcium, phosphorus aur zinc ke sources aur role
rows: Liver (jigar), gosht, anday ki zardi, khushk mewe (nuts), enriched ya saboot anaaj, phaliyan, matar aur daalein.
Laal khoon ke cells mein haemoglobin aur muscle cells mein myoglobin banane ke liye; oxygen le jane ke liye zaroori.
Doodh aur doodh ki doosri cheezein, hari sabziyan, broccoli, salmon aur sardine machhli, phaliyan, matar aur daalein.
Haddiyan aur daant banana, khoon ka theek jamna (clotting), muscles ka sukarna aur dheela hona, dil aur nerves ka kaam.
Gosht, machhli, murghi, anday, doodh, anaaj ki cheezein.

Haddiyan aur daant banane mein madad; jism ki energy (ATP) ke nikalne aur istemal ko control karta hai; phospholipids ka hissa ban kar jism mein fat le jane mein madad; jism mein acid/base balance (tawazun) qaim rakhta hai.
Bohat se enzyme systems ka hissa, maslan growth (barhwar) aur immune function (bimari se bachao ka nizam) mein; hormone insulin mein bhi hota hai.
Namak, gosht, samandari khurak, phalon ke ras, sabziyan, daal.
Jism mein fluid (paani) balance, nerves mein signal ka safar aur muscles ka kaam.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Calcium khoon jamne (coagulation) ke liye zaroori hai; is ke baghair zakhm se khoon der tak behta hai. Iron haemoglobin ka hissa hai, is liye iron ki kami se khoon ki kami (anaemia) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Khoon jamne ke liye kaun sa mineral zaroori hai? Us ka aik zariya batayein.
blocks.explanation: Calcium; maslan doodh aur doodh ki cheezein (hari sabziyan, sardines, phaliyan, matar aur daalein bhi).

items: Minerals: inorganic, energy nahi dete, magar zaroori kaam karte hain; macro aur micro (trace).
Iron (haemoglobin), calcium (haddiyan, khoon jamna), phosphorus (haddiyan, ATP), zinc (enzymes, insulin), Na/K/Cl (fluid balance, nerves).
